notes.title: The Grindstone achieves VERY POSITIVE steam rating
notes.notes:
This is a really cool milestone that happens when you get enough positive reviews in a specific amount of time- you all made that happen here at The Grindstone.

You guys are the real heroes.

I appreciate all of you and I look forward to hearing about your experience in the forums!

........and by all means keep those reviews coming :)

<3

Shane/Wolfs Moon Studios

notes.title: The Grindstone achieves positive Steam rating
notes.notes:
The Grindstone officially has a positive steam rating and I would just like to thank all of you that took the time to play and share your experience.

I truly enjoy making these games for all of you so when you tell me about your experience, likes and dislikes it really helps continue pushing things forward.

The Grindstone is the 8th title for the Studio and from the bottom of my heart I just want to thank all of you that have been so supportive and helped to push the franchise forward. 

Thank you all.

Wolfs Moon Studios

notes.title: Castle of the Black
notes.notes:
Castle of the Black is now accessible after completing The Wizard Guild quests-
Speak with Juliet Sapphire in  Almond Castle --->
Travel to the Great Library and visit the Basement

Also Placed a boatdock near Midport allowing fast travel to Jordan and New Warcford
